title: Quotestream Professional Review 2026: Pricing & Features
description: Quotestream Professional review: real-time quotes, Level 2 depth, add-on prices and market coverage, plus what the page leaves out before you subscribe.
author: Olivia Bennett
excerpt: Quotestream Professional is a QuoteMedia market data tool with add-on prices listed, but its Premium package price is not shown.
content:
Quotestream Professional is a market data and charting tool from QuoteMedia, Inc., which the site presents as the operator. It streams quotes, Level 2 depth, time and sales, and news. It does not hold client funds or place trades, so the review looks at data coverage, add-on prices and what the page leaves out.

Quotestream Professional at a Glance

Here is what the source page states and what it leaves out.

CategoryWhat the source says
OperatorQuoteMedia, Inc. (trademark holder). No separate legal entity named
Core productReal-time quotes, Level 2 depth, time and sales, charting with 100+ indicators, news and filings
Add-on pricesPaper Trading $4.95 a month; Bulk Alerts $9.95 a month for 10 alerts or $14.95 for 20 (Premium only)
Premium packageIncludes Active Sheets. Price not listed
Markets coveredNASDAQ, NYSE, AMEX, CME futures, OTC markets, LSE and several Canadian exchanges
PlatformsWeb, desktop, and native Android and iOS apps
Automated tradingNot described. Paper Trading and alerts are the automation tools listed

Items come from the reference page and the official site where we checked them. We have not tested the product.

Is Quotestream Professional Legit? What the Claims Show

Data coverage

The site lists Level 2 depth for US and several other exchanges, plus Canadian net house data. Coverage matters more than the feature list, so check that your exchange is included before you subscribe.

Add-ons and the missing Premium price

Paper Trading and Bulk Alerts have listed monthly prices, but the Premium package price is not shown. Ask for the full price list, including taxes and any exchange data fees, before you compare it with rivals.

Testimonials and endorsements

The site includes a testimonial from a product director at BMO InvestorLine, presented as a partnership endorsement. The page does not say whether compensation was involved.

Quotestream Professional Costs and Pricing

The site lists add-on prices but not the base subscription or the Premium package. Exchange data fees can be separate, so ask for a full quote that shows every recurring charge.

Our standard minimum deposit for this review is 250 in the reader's local currency. It does not apply to a data subscription, and the site does not state a deposit figure.

Who Is Behind Quotestream Professional

QuoteMedia is named as the trademark holder and operator. The site gives sales and support phone numbers, an email address and an online support centre, but no registered address or regulator, which fits a data vendor rather than a broker.

Before You Buy: A Short Checklist

  • Check that your exchange and data type are included in the plan you pick.
  • Ask for the Premium package price and a full list of exchange data fees.
  • Try Paper Trading before you pay for live alerts.
  • Confirm whether any testimonial or partnership has been paid for.

Risks to Keep in Mind

Market data is only useful if it is accurate and on time, and the page makes no latency claims beyond general streaming language. Data fees can add up quickly for multi-exchange users. The tool does not place trades, so the trading decisions remain yours.

Frequently Asked Questions

Is Quotestream Professional a broker?

No. It is a market data and charting tool from QuoteMedia and does not hold client funds or place trades.

How much does Quotestream Professional cost?

Paper Trading costs $4.95 a month and Bulk Alerts costs $9.95 to $14.95 a month. The Premium package and base price are not listed on the page.

Does Quotestream Professional have Level 2 data?

Yes. The site lists Level 2 depth for NASDAQ, NYSE, AMEX, CME futures, OTC markets, LSE and several Canadian exchanges.

Can I use Quotestream Professional on my phone?

Yes. The site lists native Android and iOS apps alongside web and desktop access.

Does Quotestream Professional trade for me?

No. The site describes data, charts, alerts and paper trading, not automated order execution.

Our Verdict on Quotestream Professional

Quotestream Professional is a data and charting tool with a clear add-on price list and broad market coverage. The missing Premium price, the exchange fees and the unclear endorsement mean buyers should get a full written quote before they compare it with other data providers. Our rating reflects these gaps. We will revisit it once the details above are confirmed.
